desc: But looking at it differently, if we apply the Stage 5 Boss logic to Futo, then she is most certainly a capable servant like Sakuya, Yōmu, Reisen, Sanae, Orin, Shō... While Tojiko is most often depicted as the "housekeeper" in fanworks 🤔 perhaps Futo would fit better as the stewardess of that house after all?
